items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I always remember, you know, Cat Anderson blowing in Tizol's ear

ctx.x: I always remember, you know, Cat Anderson blowing in Tizol's ear, thought Tizol was playing around and he kept blowing the notes in his ear, and Tizol whipped out his knife. This was when they were recording with Basie. And everybody thought it was very funny. Of course, it could have been dangerous.

Yeah. Yeah, you know, that's a hurting thing for somebody to do that in your ear anyway, you know. It seems like he's asking for something. Well, it was the same thing, you know. See, I made a contract with McShann when I didn't go with -- with --
